svg.title: Plug preset
svg.desc: Two top views of the one-sided puller, before left and after right, the plug end at the top. Left: the defaults, a 25 mm wide plug in teal. Right: plug preset set to Standard 3-prong plug - NEMA 5-15. Marked in red: 1, the zip-tie holes, the finger holes, the wing openings, the wall notch, the seat, the pocket and the body edge.
